title: Template -- RC4 Kerberos service ticket request
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description: Canonical Sigma detection template for MITRE ATT&CK T1558.003 (Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting). Detects a Kerberos service-ticket request using RC4 encryption for a non-KRBTGT service. This is a triage signal, not proof of Kerberoasting, because legacy service accounts can still require RC4. Synthetic exemplar from the WinstonRedGuard threat-intel corpus -- no actor binding; review and bind to your environment before deployment.
